title: Predictable runtime roots and unvalidated run IDs grant filesystem authority outside the verified run root
title_de: Vorhersehbare Runtime-Wurzeln und unvalidierte Run-IDs verleihen Dateisystemautorität außerhalb der verifizierten Run-Wurzel
summary: Runtime entry points accepted predictable temporary roots, mutable path fragments, and unchecked VERIFIED_RUN_ID values before downstream writers opened or cleaned paths. A local same-user attacker could redirect a report/evidence write through a parent or final symlink or escape a build directory with traversal or an absolute ID.
summary_de: Runtime-Einstiegspunkte akzeptierten vorhersehbare temporäre Wurzeln, veränderbare Pfadfragmente und ungeprüfte VERIFIED_RUN_ID-Werte, bevor nachgelagerte Writer Pfade öffneten oder bereinigten. Ein lokaler Angreifer mit demselben Benutzer konnte einen Report-/Evidence-Write über einen Parent- oder finalen Symlink umleiten oder ein Build-Verzeichnis mit Traversal oder absoluter ID verlassen.
observed_behavior: The retained pre-fix proof set demonstrated predictable-root and parent/final-symlink traversal, final-file clobbering, '..' and absolute run-ID escape, empty/overlong/Unicode-separator acceptance, foreign-file adoption, parallel non-exclusive creation, and an lstat-to-open replacement race.
observed_behavior_de: Der erhaltene Pre-Fix-Nachweissatz demonstrierte vorhersehbare Wurzel- und Parent-/Final-Symlink-Traversierung, Final-File-Clobbering, '..'- und absolute Run-ID-Escapes, Akzeptanz leerer/überlanger/Unicode-Separator-IDs, Foreign-File-Adoption, parallele nicht-exklusive Erstellung und eine lstat-zu-open-Ersetzungs-Race.
expected_behavior: Every runtime artifact remains below a current-user-owned, capability-bound 0700 verified root; run IDs are bounded allowlist values before joins; no symlink is followed; foreign files are not adopted or overwritten; creation/open is exclusive or descriptor-bound; cleanup unlinks a symlink leaf without following it.
expected_behavior_de: Jedes Runtime-Artefakt bleibt unterhalb einer dem aktuellen Benutzer gehörenden capability-gebundenen 0700-verifizierten Wurzel; Run-IDs sind vor Joins begrenzte Allowlist-Werte; kein Symlink wird verfolgt; Fremddateien werden weder adoptiert noch überschrieben; Erstellung/Öffnung ist exklusiv oder deskriptorgebunden; Cleanup unlinkt ein Symlink-Leaf ohne ihm zu folgen.
impact: Unauthorized local filesystem writes, evidence/report corruption, and deletion or overwrite of a target selected through a same-user symlink/path race were possible outside the intended runtime root.
impact_de: Nicht autorisierte lokale Dateisystemschreibvorgänge, Evidence-/Report-Korruption und Löschen oder Überschreiben eines über eine Same-User-Symlink-/Pfadrace gewählten Ziels waren außerhalb der vorgesehenen Runtime-Wurzel möglich.
preconditions: A local attacker can create or replace a temporary/runtime path component under a writable ancestor.
A runtime entry point consumes the supplied root or run ID before the fixed validation/open boundary.
reproduction: Pre-create a root, parent, or final symlink to a foreign sentinel and invoke the affected runtime writer.
Supply '..', an absolute path, empty, overlong, or Unicode-separator VERIFIED_RUN_ID and observe a join or acceptance before the fix.
Race a directory/file replacement between legacy validation and pathname open.

evidence.command: rtk env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TMPDIR=<task-run>/tmp /root/git/ModSecurity-conector/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest -v tests.test_runtime_env_snapshot_contract tests.test_verified_runtime_path_hardening tests.test_runtime_artifact_io_hardening tests.test_mrts_native_full_path_hardening

root_cause: String-derived runtime path authority was trusted across root allocation, run-ID propagation, direct writers, reads, and cleanup. Path containment checks were incomplete and did not provide descriptor ownership, no-follow, exclusive creation, or a per-root capability for existing roots.
root_cause_de: String-abgeleitete Runtime-Pfadautorität wurde über Wurzelallokation, Run-ID-Propagation, direkte Writer, Reads und Cleanup vertraut. Pfadcontainment-Prüfungen waren unvollständig und lieferten keine Deskriptor-Ownership, No-Follow, exklusive Erstellung oder eine Pro-Wurzel-Capability für bestehende Wurzeln.
proposed_remediation: PR A implements descriptor-relative lstat/no-follow/exclusive primitives, 0700 capability-bound roots, a bounded ASCII run-ID allowlist, ownership records, secure shell/Python bridges, and safe cleanup across mapped runtime writers.
proposed_remediation_de: PR A implementiert deskriptorrelative lstat/No-Follow/exklusive Primitive, 0700-capability-gebundene Wurzeln, eine begrenzte ASCII-Run-ID-Allowlist, Ownership-Records, sichere Shell-/Python-Brücken und sicheres Cleanup über die abgebildeten Runtime-Writer.
acceptance_criteria: All permitted artifacts remain below a canonical verified root with restrictive ownership and modes.
Root/parent/final symlink, traversal, absolute, empty/long/Unicode run-ID, foreign-file, parallel, race, and cleanup controls fail without changing the foreign sentinel.
Normal valid runtime controls succeed and Parent, Framework, and MRTS remain non-targets.
validation_plan: Re-run the original and alternate symlink/traversal/race controls on the exact PR head.
Run focused runtime path, artifact IO, snapshot, and MRTS-native synthetic tests plus shell static checks.
Verify the exact delivery PR head before changing status beyond fixed.
legitimate_control_tests: Normal private owned runtime artifact creation.
Valid bounded run ID and synthetic Parent-only runtime staging.
blocked_by: Framework/MRTS end-to-end integration is blocked_missing_evidence, but does not invalidate Parent local containment proof.
deduplication_note: Distinct from FND-PARENT-0034 because report publication has a separate trusted write authority; distinct from FND-PARENT-0035 because raw rules reach Library sinks after runtime root preparation.
residual_risk: Parent-local remediation is tested and fixed, but remains delivery-pending until the exact PR head has remote CI/review evidence. Framework/MRTS integration is a recorded evidence gap, not a risk acceptance.
residual_risk_de: Die Parent-lokale Remediation ist getestet und fixed, bleibt aber delivery-pending, bis der exakte PR-Head Remote-CI-/Review-Evidenz besitzt. Framework-/MRTS-Integration ist eine festgehaltene Evidenzlücke, keine Risikoakzeptanz.

history.detail: Pre-fix exploit classes were reproduced; PR A exact-head focused controls passed. Delivery verification and no-merge PR status remain pending.
